components.allowTrivial: The meter starts at zero on the grid. Before the fix the bank read the raw per-tick tyre load and flipped its full +-3.15 deg in one tick mid-corner, 6.2 deg measured; smoothed it measured 0.51 deg, so 1.5 deg catches the flip.

The second difference of the camera yaw, teleport cuts excluded. The raw velocity heading jerked 84 deg in one tick; eased like the kart camera it measured 5.7 deg at a full right-to-left steer reversal, so 15 deg catches a snap.
The body lean read the same raw load and flipped its full +-5 deg, 10 deg in one tick, the shake on the car. Smoothed it measured 0.81 deg, so 2 deg catches the flip and leaves the real lean room.
Four seconds of full throttle reach racing speed, so the corners the meter reads are taken at speed and not on the parked grid.
